task: P.C2 stage 1: reach (exclusion) rates, F/R/RC gap differences and decision changes on natural blind-bid positions

approval.caps_set_by: implementer, stated to the owner before the run

baseline: B0 best_agents(worlds=128); its bid search uses the F reconstruction (uniform worlds, random eligible NOLO cards for earlier seats)
process_library: R0-parity 221fe041 (bitwise == B0 on the A03 probe set); needed for explicit-world evaluation and forks

population.source: natural v3 deals by best_agents(worlds=128) at all seats, fresh agents per deal, played through showing only
population.focal_positions: every blind bid actually reached with at least one earlier bidder (reveal position k >= 1); forehand bids are counted, not evaluated (R = F exactly there)

evaluation.env_sooli_settings: cold (as for an agent's first call)
evaluation.calibration: first 4 evaluated positions: the earlier seats' bids on the first 6 worlds recomputed by fresh W128 forks (C2.02 SearchPredecessor)
evaluation.validation: where F, R and RC pick different bids: those bids re-evaluated on 256 fresh independent worlds (stream validation|c2-screen|<source>|<k>) with clone predecessors; paired difference R/RC pick minus F pick under that model, with its standard error

measurements: exclusion rate 1 - P(E | focal observation) per position under the clone model, by k
the same under W128 search predecessors (calibration) and per-world agreement with the clone model
conditional gaps F, R, RC per action; argmax under each; max |R - F| and |RC - R|
estimated decision regret of F under the R (and RC) model: gap_R(argmax_R) - gap_R(argmax_F)

caps.rule: stop before a deal (or before calibration) if spent + expected cost would exceed a cap
caps.note: 720 CPU-s stage budget minus the 81 CPU-s pre-flight

not_claimed: no strength claim; 64 worlds per position gives noisy argmax comparisons; clone predecessors are a model
amended: 2026-09-26 after the 2-deal pre-flight: added independent validation (winner's-curse guard); calibration cut to 4 positions
